fields.title: Bonded sandwich conductance and core-gap radiation
fields.finding: Solid-metal conduction, adhesive contact resistance and core-cell radiation are distinct. Neither zero resistance nor effective gap emissivity .20 is a measured installed value.
fields.needed: Measure CR-III/AF163/Be conductance with actual cure, contact area, coating and evacuated cells; retain the zero/.20 gap alternatives.

claim: Solid-metal conduction, adhesive contact resistance and core-cell radiation are distinct. Neither zero resistance nor effective gap emissivity .20 is a measured installed value. | Bonded sandwich conductance and core-gap radiation
numerical_scope: Source NFI carried without a new independent check
qualification: The common equations do not qualify the bond, core law, coatings or installed safety factor. Carry the exact conventions, not an interchangeable headline. [052 disposition](unpublished-local-ref:3a70e117fbb14e85), [CHECK053](unpublished-local-ref:599d3a276c2fcbce).
